svg.title: Thanawat Ueasiripracha
svg.desc: A hard-drive datasheet label for Thanawat Ueasiripracha, aspiring data engineer, CS student at Khon Kaen University, manufacturing intern at Seagate. A spinning platter with a seeking read head sits on the right.

g.text: Data engineer in training. I build pipelines, check whether
models hold up off their own benchmark, and ship small tools.
